{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u011/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f8135a7a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the colored marker shape onto each all-zero occurrence in the grid."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 5)}
    # The ARC background is binary noise; the single non-background marker
    # color identifies both the shape and the color to copy.
    if not colors:
        return out
    color = next(iter(colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells]
    sh, sw = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    for r in range(h - sh + 1):
        for c in range(w - sw + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return out
"
